Agent 实际使用

注册资源 Service 并暴露 /api/resources CRUD；注册文件上传路由并叠加认证；页面通过 useService 取得文件管理器、通过 useApiClient 调业务 API。正常组合
框架职责与业务边界
框架负责：DI 容器/令牌/生命周期、路由贡献与 scope、客户端 hooks 与页面路由；应用负责：具体 service 实现、业务 REST 路由与鉴权策略、页面组件。
推荐使用方式
ServiceProvider.register 中用 createServiceToken + container.singleton 注册；用 defineApiRoutes/defineRootRoutes 贡献路由并在应用侧挂 auth guard；defineAppRoutes 注册页面，useService/useApiClient 访问。
Agent 实际使用
应用 ResourceServiceProvider 以 createServiceToken + container.singleton 注册 DefaultResourceService；server/routes 把插件 fileRoutes 映射为 defineApiRoutes 并在 /resources 路径挂 auth.required，root scope 保持公开；client routes.ts 用 defineAppRoutes，resources.tsx 用 useService(clientFileRepositoryManagerToken) 与 useApiClient。

做得好的地方 1

服务端以固定列 + contentUrl 契约完整支撑附件上传与真实字节分发
NocoBase3 插件评审者判断 · 有证据信息已解决
⌄

FILE_COLUMNS 固定了必须写入的元数据列（E1），store() 归一化文件名/扩展名并以实际存储大小复核 file.size（E3），uploadOne 落盘后 createOne 并补 contentUrl（E2），上传路由 decorate 返回记录（E4），content route 按 UUID+ext 提供字节并设置安全头（E5）。应用只需给文件集合加一个关联列即可完成附件需求。

实际影响 / 提供的帮助
业务可用极少代码接入上传、刷新读取、预览与下载，且元数据列与存储列职责清晰。
建议改法 / 应保留的能力
在 Skill 中继续保留该契约，并明确 getUrl 与 content route 的对应关系及固定列必须齐全。

问题 1

Registry 图片预览分支在解码失败时没有错误反馈
NocoBase3 插件评审者判断 · 有证据轻微未解决
⌄

FilePreviewContent 的 image 分支直接渲染 <img>，只有 error/loading 前置判断，没有 onError（E6）；损坏图片只显示破图。应用不得不扩展 ImagePreview，用 onError 切到 role='alert' 并给 DownloadFallback（E24），才让 B04 的清晰错误反馈通过（E23）。

实际影响 / 提供的帮助
使用默认 Registry 组件的应用在预览损坏图片时缺少可读失败反馈，需求“损坏文件给清晰错误”需要业务自行补齐。
建议改法 / 应保留的能力
在 image 分支增加 onError 失败态与下载回退（或暴露可插拔错误回调），并在 Skill 的 Preview and content access 章节说明该约定。

Registry OOXML 预览缺少加载超时，静默无响应会一直停在 Loading preview...
NocoBase3 插件评审者判断 · 有证据轻微未解决

office-open-xml-preview 在 viewer.load() resolve 前只显示 Loading preview，错误仅由 viewer 的 onError 回调暴露，没有超时降级（E10）；Skill 只承诺“请求或渲染失败显示错误”（E13），未覆盖既不 resolve 也不 reject 的无响应情形。B02 的 stuck 状态正是这种表现（E22）。

建议改法 / 应保留的能力
为 OOXML 加载引入可配置超时，超时后切换到错误态并显示下载回退（注意大文档需放宽阈值），并在 Skill 验证章节补充无响应用例。

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

    'id',
    'disk',
    'key',
    'filename',
    'ext',
    'mimeType',
    'size',
    'createdAt',

            uploadOne: async ({ file }) => {
                await validateCollection();

                const owned = [];

                return {

                .normalize('NFC')
                // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Strip controls from an untrusted filename.
                .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, '')
                .trim() || 'file';
            const suffix = filename.lastIndexOf('.') > 0
                ? filename.slice(filename.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase()
                : '';

                        if (typeof entry.policy === 'function') {
                            const principal = await options.principal?.(c);
                            if (principal === undefined || principal === null)
                                return c.json({
                                    code: 'PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED',
                                    message: 'This endpoint requires a principal and none was resolved.',
                                }, 403);
                            writable = resolve(app, entry, entry.policy(principal));
                        }
                        else {
                            writable = resolve(app, entry, entry.policy);
                        }
                        if (!c.req
                            .header('content-type')
                            ?.toLowerCase()
                            .startsWith('multipart/form-data;'))
                            return c.json({
                                code: 'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE',
                                message: 'Expected multipart/form-data.',
                            }, 415);
                        let body;
                        try {
                            body = await c.req.parseBody({ all: true });
                        }
                        catch {
                            return c.json({
                                code: 'INVALID_MULTIPART',
                                message: 'Invalid multipart body.',
                            }, 400);
                        }
                        const value = body.file;
                        if (action === 'uploadOne') {
                            if (!(value instanceof File))
                                return c.json({
                                    code: 'INVALID_FILE',
                                    message: 'Exactly one File is required.',
                                }, 400);
                            return c.json({
                                data: decorate(await writable.uploadOne({ file: value }), getUrl, true),
                            });
                        }
                        const uploads = Array.isArray(value)
                            ? value
                            : value === undefined
                                ? []
                                : [value];
                        if (!uploads.length ||
                            !uploads.every((file) => file instanceof File))
                            return c.json({
                                code: 'INVALID_FILES',
                                message: 'At least one File is required.',
                            }, 400);
                        return c.json({
                            data: decorate(await writable.uploadMany({ files: uploads }), getUrl, true),
                        });

async function downloadFile(file: FileRecord): Promise<void> {
  const raw = file.contentUrl;
  const url = raw ? resolveSafeFileUrl(raw) : undefined;
  if (!url) throw new Error('File URL is not allowed.');
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = file.filename;
  link.rel = 'noopener';
  link.click();
}

function reportDownloadError(
  onError: ((error: Error) => void) | undefined,
  error: unknown,
): void {
  onError?.(
    error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('File download failed.'),
  );
}

  const upload = async (item: UploadItem): Promise<void> => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    setItems((current) =>
      current.map((candidate) =>
        candidate.key === item.key
          ? { ...candidate, status: 'uploading', controller, error: undefined }
          : candidate,
      ),
    );
    try {
      const { record } = await repository.uploadOne(
        { file: item.file },
        { signal: controller.signal },
      );
      controllersRef.current.delete(item.key);
      if (!mountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setItems((current) =>
        current.filter((candidate) => candidate.key !== item.key),
      );
      commitCompletedRecord(record);
    } catch (error) {
      controllersRef.current.delete(item.key);
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        (error instanceof Error && error.name === 'AbortError')
      ) {
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setItems((current) =>
            current.filter((candidate) => candidate.key !== item.key),
          );
        }
        return;
      }
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      const uploadError =
        error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('File upload failed.');
      setItems((current) =>
        current.map((candidate) =>
          candidate.key === item.key
            ? { ...candidate, error: uploadError, status: 'error' }
            : candidate,
        ),
      );
      onError?.(uploadError);
    }
  };

## Find and reuse the preview UI first

Inspect `client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/` before writing upload or preview components. Current Default templates preinstall this application-owned Registry source and its client dependencies; older applications and other templates may not. Import from its `index.ts`, not from plugin-internal paths. Registering the plugin supplies services and translations; it does not automatically install or upgrade the copied UI.

| Format                                               | Registry preview                  | Content access                                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| DOCX / XLSX / PPTX                                   | Local `@silurus/ooxml` viewer     | Same-origin session credentials; no public URL or third-party service required |
| Raster image / PDF / text / Markdown / audio / video | Built-in preview components       | See the content access rules below                                             |
| Legacy DOC / XLS / PPT and OpenDocument              | Office Online fallback            | Internet-accessible absolute URL; cannot use the App session                   |
| Unsupported or unsafe active content                 | Explanation and optional download | Download still requires permission                                             |

For custom attachment lists, uploads or business associations, reuse `FilePreviewDialog` with file records and `contentUrl`; it requires no repository prop. Extend the existing UI or add the necessary content adapter rather than reimplementing format detection and dropping supported formats. A DOCX download fallback indicates a request/rendering failure or an outdated/custom component, not that the plugin lacks DOCX support. Report the actual failure and preserve its evidence.

E13 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:229–239

Registry 章节说明各控件 props 与 removeOnDelete 语义；预览章节给出 OOXML 本地渲染、同源凭据、Bearer 适配与“请求或渲染失败显示错误并给下载回退”的约定。

FileUploadField takes a repository and controlled value/onChange; onStatusChange reports idle/uploading/error so forms can prevent incomplete submissions. Accept/maxSize/maxFiles are UI checks. removeOnDelete calls deleteOne, deleting metadata only; otherwise removal unlinks the selection. Read-only FileList, FileThumbnail, FilePreviewField and FilePreviewDialog use contentUrl without a repository prop. Import UI types from the installed recipe. Supply translated labels and adapt App-owned source as needed.

### Preview and content access

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

```ts
// database/main/migrations/202609020001_create_orders.ts
import { defineMigration, type MigrationDefinition } from '@nocobase/db';

const migration: MigrationDefinition = defineMigration({
  name: '202609020001_create_orders',

  async up({ builder }) {
    await builder.createCollection('orders', (collection) => {
      collection.increments('id');
      collection.string('orderNo', { length: 64, nullable: false });
      collection.string('status', { length: 32, nullable: false });
      collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false });
      collection.unique('orderNo');
      collection.index('status');
    });
  },

  async down({ builder }) {
    await builder.dropCollection('orders');
  },
});

export default migration;
```

```ts
// database/main/seeds/202609030002_default_order_statuses.ts
import { defineSeed } from '@nocobase/db';

export default defineSeed({
  name: '202609030002_default_order_statuses',

  async run({ repository }) {
    await repository('orderStatuses').upsertOne({
      filter: { code: 'draft' },
      create: { code: 'draft', title: 'Draft' },
      update: { title: 'Draft' },
    });
  },
});
```

Apply both with `pnpm db:apply`, adding `--connection <name>` for a non-default connection or `--all` for every managed one.

Each context carries its own tools, and which one to use is not a free choice — see [Repository and Query](#4-repository-and-query). In short: a migration works through `builder` and `query`, and a seed writes through `repository`.

function ImagePreview(inputProps: {
  readonly file: FileRecord;
  readonly url?: string;
  readonly onDownload?: () => void;
}): ReactElement {
  const { t } = useTranslation('@nocobase/app-plugin-file');
  const { file, url, onDownload } = inputProps;
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  if (failed)
    return (
      <div className='space-y-3'>
        <div
          role='alert'
          className='rounded-md border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-sm text-destructive'
        >
          {t('files.imageFailed', {
            defaultValue:
              'The image could not be displayed. The file may be corrupted or not a valid image.',
          })}
        </div>
        <DownloadFallback file={file} onDownload={onDownload} />
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <img
      src={url}
      alt={file.filename}
      className='max-h-[70vh] max-w-full object-contain'
      onError={() => setFailed(true)}
    />
  );
}

E25 · app/server/routes/index.ts:151–175

应用把插件 fileRoutes 映射为 defineApiRoutes，在 /resources 与 /resourceFiles:uploadOne 路径上挂 authenticationToken.required()，并把 root scope 路由原样保留为公开字节路由。

const routes: readonly AppRouteContribution<Application>[] = fileRoutes.map(
  (route) => {
    if (route.scope === 'root') return route;
    return defineApiRoutes(async (app) => {
      const secured = new Hono<AuthEnv>();
      // The guard is attached to the exact paths this contribution owns. A
      // `use('*', ...)` here would be merged into the parent router and would
      // answer 401 for unrelated paths that should fall through to the SPA.
      const guard = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken).required();
      secured.use('/resources', guard);
      secured.use('/resources/:id', guard);
      secured.use('/resourceFiles:uploadOne', guard);
      registerResourceRoutes(
        secured,
        app.container.resolve(resourceServiceToken),
      );
      secured.route('/', await route.createRouter(app));
      // The contribution factory's env carries no application variables, so the
      // secured router is nested inside a plain one rather than returned as-is.
      const router = new Hono();
      router.route('/', secured);
      return router;
    });
  },
);

E27 · app/server/providers/resources.ts:190–222

DefaultResourceService 用 fileRows.updateOne 关联文件、findMany 过滤当前关联，并在 replaceAttachments 中删除不再保留的元数据行。

  private async associate(
    resourceId: number,
    fileIds: readonly string[],
  ): Promise<void> {
    for (const id of fileIds) {
      await this.fileRows.updateOne({
        filter: { id },
        values: { resourceId, updatedAt: new Date() },
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Makes the resource's attachments exactly `fileIds`: newly named rows are
   * associated, rows that are no longer named are deleted. Deleting the row
   * rather than only clearing `resourceId` is what makes a removed attachment
   * disappear completely after a refresh.
   */
  private async replaceAttachments(
    resourceId: number,
    fileIds: readonly string[],
  ): Promise<void> {
    const keep = new Set(fileIds);
    const current = await this.fileRows.findMany({
      filter: { resourceId },
    });
    for (const row of current) {
      if (!keep.has(row.id)) {
        await this.fileRows.deleteOne({ filter: { id: row.id } });
      }
    }
    await this.associate(resourceId, fileIds);
  }

E29 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:143–160

Builder 章节只展示 await builder.createCollection(name, callback) 及字段构建器，未提及批量 createCollections。

## 3. Builder

`builder` is the schema API, and a migration is where it belongs. Runtime code has `db.builder()` available and should not use it: schema that changes outside the migration history is schema nothing can reproduce.

`createCollection(name, callback)` takes a callback, not a field array:

```ts
await builder.createCollection('orderItems', (collection) => {
  collection.increments('id');
  collection.integer('orderId', { nullable: false });
  collection.integer('quantity', { nullable: false, defaultValue: 1 });
  collection.foreignKey('orderId', {
    references: { collection: 'orders', fields: ['id'] },
    name: 'fk_order_items_order',
  });
  collection.index(['orderId', 'quantity']);
});
```

  name: '202609240001_seed_resources',

    const resources = context.repository<ResourceSeedRow>('resources');
    for (const title of resourceTitles) {
      const existing = await resources.findOne({ filter: { title } });
      if (existing) continue;
      const now = new Date();
      await resources.createOne({
        values: { title, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now },
      });
    }
  },
});

export class ResourceServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider<Application> {
  readonly name = 'app-resources';

  register(): void {
    this.app.container.singleton(resourceServiceToken, (container) => {
      const manager = container.resolve(serverFileRepositoryManagerToken);
      const files = manager.repository(RESOURCE_FILES_COLLECTION, {
        disk: RESOURCE_FILES_DISK,
        accessPath: RESOURCE_FILES_ACCESS_PATH,
        // Read-only use of `getUrl`; every write goes through the application's
        // own service routes, which do their own authentication.
        policy: { read: false, create: false, update: false, delete: false },
      });
      return new DefaultResourceService({
        database: container.resolve(databaseManagerToken),
        files,
        publicBasePath: () => this.app.publicBasePath,
      });
    });

原始验收要求

新增资料并上传 PNG，保存、刷新后能预览真实图片并下载。

实际操作

  1. 登录后打开 /main/resources 资料附件页，确认已有示例资料列表
  2. 点击 New resource 新建资料，标题填 PNG photo record
  3. 通过文件控件的 Choose files 上传夹具 sample.png (99 bytes)
  4. 点击 Save 提交附件关联
  5. 整页刷新 /main/resources 后重新打开 PNG photo record，附件仍显示 1 条
  6. 点击 Preview: sample.png，弹窗显示真实图片而非文件名占位
  7. 点击 Download: sample.png，agent-browser 返回 Download was canceled，目标路径无文件
  8. 用直接挂载到 DOM 的 <a download> 指向同一 contentUrl 下载，得到与夹具 sha256 一致的 PNG

观察结果

  1. 保存并整页刷新后列表计数仍为 1，详情附件列表仍显示 sample.png（image/png）
  2. Preview 弹窗 <img> 实际解码成功，naturalWidth=32、naturalHeight=32，是真实蓝色方块图片
  3. 点击 Download 按钮触发 Browser.downloadWillBegin（URL=http://127.0.0.1:13000/main/uploads/resourceFiles/<id>.png、建议文件名 sample.png），服务端返回 99 字节，随后状态变为 canceled，未生成文件
  4. 直接 <a download> 下载同一 URL 得到字节与夹具 sample.png 一致的副本，说明文件存储/服务端点正确
  5. preflight.download=true；本项受阻是该工具的 download 命令无法捕获应用脚本触发的脱离 DOM 下载，而非缺少下载能力

02

为另一条资料上传 DOCX，保存、刷新后在应用内看到文档真实内容；不能以文件名截图代替预览。

环境受阻：DOCX 上传、保存、刷新后关联仍在均通过；应用内预览停在 “Loading preview...” 超过 40s。实测主线程已向 module blob worker 发送 {type:init, wasmUrl:...} 和 {type:parse, data:975B}，但 worker 从未请求 docx_parser_bg-*.wasm（网络无该请求），即首批消息在 worker 的 await import(containment bootstrap) 期间被丢弃。工厂的 browser-worker-compat.js 本轮未生效：新构造的 guarded bootstrap blob 未被加入消息缓冲（fetch 该 blob 看不到 __factoryWorkerEvents）。给 Worker.prototype.postMessage 注入 1.5s 延迟让消息在 worker 就绪后到达，同一预览立即渲染出正文 “Factory DOCX sample”，证明应用预览实现正确，属测试环境的 worker containment 竞态阻塞。
